description:
Open the interaction profile for the cancer drug 'Midostaurin' in the Liverpool Cancer iChart Archive app. Scroll through its co-medication interaction list and systematically identify ONE example co-medication for EACH of the five traffic light colors: Red (Do Not Coadminister), Orange (Potential Interaction), Yellow (Potential Weak Interaction), Green (No Interaction Expected), and Grey (No Clear Data).

For each color found, tap on the entry to reveal the detail view (or ensure the color bar is clearly visible) before moving to the next. You must find at least one distinct example for all 5 colors.
